releaseDecision: The assembled reference is usable, but both atlas candidates are rejected because decoded pixels are fully opaque and contain a baked checkerboard. No skeleton approval or stress-pose render was attempted from invalid source art.
verifiedBehavior: The runtime and smoke fixture reject clean-cut or reconstruction-invalid candidates and preserve them for bounded regeneration. The generated atlas failures therefore block only the generated rig candidate, not the Phase 4.1 validation pipeline release.
